rollback_validation.design: Rollback reads immutable snapshot.original_amount_cents and restores exact original values. Must include optimistic check before applying: only apply if current state matches expected post-recovery state. Otherwise fail with CONFLICT.
staging_test_plan: In staging, create fixture with amount=100000000
Run rollback reading snapshot and verify amount restored to 100000000
Simulate conflict: change current amount to 2000000 before rollback; verify rollback refuses and reports CONFLICT

audit_validation.design: Audit events must record full recovery lifecycle (scanner, evidence verification, human decision, snapshot, execution, verification, rollback). Must be emitted to an immutable audit store (append-only) with unique operation id.
staging_test_plan: Configure staging audit sink (file or test DB)
Simulate recovery lifecycle and ensure audit events emitted with required fields
Verify audit event can reconstruct the full lifecycle and includes evidence references and checksums
audit_validation.existing_evidence: modules/audit/historical-data-audit.service.ts indicates an audit component; further verification required in staging

balance_validation.design: Define whether account.current_balance_cents is a materialized aggregate or must be recomputed from transactions. Recovery must either: (A) update the balance deterministically and atomically with the transaction change, or (B) reconstruct balances from ledger entries in a validated process. A reconciliation test must be run in staging.
staging_test_plan: Create staging account with opening_balance_cents=1000000 and transactions including an amount of 100000000
Simulate applying correction to 1000000 in staging under controlled code path
Verify account.current_balance_cents is updated according to documented strategy (or ledger recalculation confirms expected totals)
Run rollback and verify balances restored

staging_test_plan: Simulate concurrent recovery attempts against the same candidate and verify only one succeeds

Simulate candidate state change before execution resulting in zero rows affected and classification STALE_OR_ALREADY_CHANGED
